data.description: 'setup-refspec' writes remote.origin.fetch = 'refs/etch/sessions/*:refs/etch/sessions/*' (no leading '+'), but the README's 'Equivalent manual config' shows '+refs/etch/sessions/*:refs/etch/sessions/*' (force/non-fast-forward allowed). Doc vs implementation mismatch. Harmless for immutable per-session refs, but the two should agree. Pick one and make both match.
data.title: setup-refspec fetch refspec omits leading '+' that README's manual-equivalent shows

data.body: Subsumed by ETCH-38: fetch refspec now written with the leading '+' ('+refs/etch/sessions/*:refs/etch/sessions/*'), matching README's manual-equivalent; legacy no-'+' entries are upgraded in place when setup-refspec is rerun. Landed in PR #19 (https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/19). Closing as duplicate per run-state decision.
